packageScripts.name: cf:deploy
packageScripts.command: ARCHESTIMATOR_CLOUDFLARE_BUILD=1 opennextjs-cloudflare build && OPEN_NEXT_DEPLOY=true CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false wrangler deploy --keep-vars

packageScripts.name: gen:types
packageScripts.command: supabase gen types typescript --project-id ebxxqidacheyapmmzavr --schema public > src/lib/supabase/types.ts

packageScripts.name: storybook:validate
packageScripts.command: bun run storybook:check-components && bun run storybook:check-boundary && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 bun run build-storybook -- --output-dir /tmp/archestimator-storybook-static-standalone

packageScripts.name: validate
packageScripts.command: bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run lint:design-system && bun run lint:design && bun run test && bun run test:dom
